next_probe: Search for authoritative commit-id normalization/validation; if absent, prepare a schema-only superseding clarification that preserves historical receipts and separates commit_id from digest fields.
closure_gate: Explicit versioned commit-id semantics + executable validator + append-only migration/supersession rule; no historical receipt rewrite.
